goal: Prevent compiler and static analysis false positives by warning on missing noreturn annotations
Enforce consistent annotations on functions, methods, and lambdas that do not return
agreement: Unaddressed objection: compiler errors in fuzz tests and Windows builds under Clang and MSVC (maflcko)
Open suggestion: avoid marking functions virtual if overrides could return to prevent UB (stickies-v)

categories.name: build
why: P4 because it adds a compiler warning flag as a diagnostic safeguard without affecting binary correctness
Minor build maintenance that helps keep compiler diagnostics clean
